review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 56) consolidates Lessons 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: Mupanda 1a/2a Honorific Kinship Noun; Mupanda 2 Prefix (va-); Class 2 (va-) Past Subject Concord; Mupanda 1 (mu-) Noun. Example utterances reviewed: "mbuya vangu vakazvara mwana anemusoro mukuru uye ane nhova yakapfava zvingaite dambudziko here kana kuti anotofanira kunoongoorwa kuchipatara" | "kana uchiri mwana mudiki zvekuti makore 17 and below ndino zviona sei kuti ndabata mimba kana kuti handina" | "ndakanzwa pa radio zvichinzi vakadzi vanofanira kutariswa cancer yechibereko so ndanga ndichida kuziva kuti ndinotangira papi"

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'mbuya vangu vakazvara mwana anemusoro mukuru uye ane nhova yakapfava zvingaite dambudziko here kana kuti anotofanira kunoongoorwa ______' (Zezuru utterance (grandmother / respected elder woman / people / elders [ngu] / they did [zvara] / child / anemusoro / person / singular / inside [kuru] / uye / ane))
review_exercises.explanation: 'kuchipatara' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'kana uchiri mwana mudiki zvekuti makore 17 and below ndino zviona sei kuti ndabata mimba kana kuti ______' (Zezuru utterance (kana / uchiri / child / person / singular / inside [diki] / zvekuti / you (resp.) have [kore] / 17 / and))
review_exercises.explanation: 'handina' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'ndakanzwa pa radio zvichinzi vakadzi vanofanira kutariswa cancer yechibereko so ndanga ndichida kuziva kuti ndinotangira ______' (Zezuru utterance (I did [nzwa] / pa / radio / things / manner [chinzi] / they did [dzi] / they / elders habitually [fanira] / to (infinitive) / towards [tariswa] / cancer))
review_exercises.explanation: 'papi' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'pakuyamwisa mapatya kana ndakange ndazvara mapatya ndokwanisa kuyamwisa vese ka1 here kana kuti ndinofanira kuyamwisa 1 at a ______' (Zezuru utterance (at / on (specific point) [kuyamwisa] / you (resp.) have [patya] / kana / I did [nge] / I have [zvara] / you (resp.) have [patya] / ndokwanisa / to (infinitive) / towards [yamwisa]))
review_exercises.explanation: 'time' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'kana mwana achango bva kuzvarwa achibuda mate akawandisa wandisa zvinoreva here kuti mazino ake akubuda kana kuti kungowandawo kwemate ______' (Zezuru utterance (kana / child / achango / bva / to (infinitive) / towards [zvarwa] / achibuda / you (resp.) have [te] / he/she did [wandisa]))
review_exercises.explanation: 'mumukanwa' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'vakuru vaititi kuhotsira ______ koreva kuti pane munhu anenge achimufunga ichokwadi here uye ndinga misa sei kuhotsira kwemwana' (Zezuru utterance (people / elders [kuru] / people / elders [ititi] / to (infinitive) / towards [hotsira] / kwemwana / koreva / to (infinitive) / towards [ti] / at / on (specific point) [ne] / person / singular / inside [nhu]))
review_exercises.explanation: 'kwemwana' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
